taiwan_aviation.headline: 星達航空首條歐洲航線開通台北-布拉格航班
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星達航空於8月1日啟動首條歐洲航線，台北桃園至布拉格航班，葉哲威主席親自執飛。航班以A350-900營運，將於9月改用A350-1000，週二、四、六三班，10月起增至四班。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Airlines launches first European route with Taipei-Prague flight
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines launched its first European route on August 1, 2026, with an inaugural Taipei-Prague flight piloted by Chairman K.W. Chang. The route initially operates with an A350-900 before switching to an A350-1000 on September 1, with three weekly flights increasing to four from October 1.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空重啟84英哩超短程航線 每日規劃三班區域客機
international_aviation.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，美國航空正在重啟一條航程僅84英哩的超短程航線，該航線距離上次營運已有27年歷史。美國航空規劃針對此航線提供每日三班的定期航班服務，並預計採用65座的區域客機進行執飛，重新為該區段提供空中運輸服務。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines Launches 84-Mile Route Last Flown 27 Years Ago
international_aviation.summary_en: American Airlines is resurrecting an ultra-short 84-mile route that was last flown 27 years ago, according to information published by Simple Flying on August 3, 2026. The air carrier plans to operate three daily flights on the regional route using 65-seater regional jets. The launch marks the resumption of commercial flight operations on this specific route segment after nearly three decades without service, adding an extremely short sector back into the airline's operational network schedule.

international_aviation.headline: 波音737 MAX 10完成最後認證試飛 朝2026取證再邁一步
international_aviation.summary: 波音宣布737 MAX 10已完成所有規劃的認證飛行測試，累計近千架次飛行、超過2,000小時。公司仍以2026年取得FAA認證、2027年開始交付為目標，同時737 MAX 7認證文件進度約95%。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing 737 MAX 10 wraps final certification flight testing, targets FAA nod in 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing has completed planned certification flight testing of the 737 MAX 10, logging nearly 1,000 flights and more than 2,000 hours. The manufacturer continues to target FAA certification in 2026 and first customer deliveries in 2027, while MAX 7 certification documentation is roughly 95% complete.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士A321XLR面世挑戰傳統樞紐航網模式
international_aviation.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士 A320 家族最新成員 A321XLR 正在直接挑戰傳統的樞紐航網模式，未來可能引發全球航空網路結構的緩慢轉變。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus A321XLR Challenges Traditional Hub-and-Spoke Airline Network Model
international_aviation.summary_en: According to aviation news website Simple Flying, the traditional airline hub-and-spoke operational model is being directly challenged by the Airbus A321XLR, the latest narrowbody aircraft to join the popular A320 family. The deployment of this long-range single-aisle aircraft is expected to slowly usher in a global change to airline flight networks, allowing operators to bypass hubs. This structural shift comes as the manufacturer continues to scale up its operations, aiming to achieve a production rate of 70 to 75 A320 family aircraft per month by late 2027.

international_aviation.headline: 瑞士 Edelweiss 航空任命 Wolfensberger 接任執行長
international_aviation.summary: 瑞士休閒航空 Edelweiss Air 宣布，現任 Eurowings 營運長 Edi Wolfensberger 將於 2026 年 10 月 1 日接任執行長，接替掌舵 12 年的 Bernd Bauer。在其領導下，該公司的航點網路從約 40 個擴展至 100 多個航點，員工數也顯著成長。
international_aviation.headline_en: Edelweiss Air Appoints Edi Wolfensberger as CEO to Succeed Bernd Bauer
international_aviation.summary_en: Swiss leisure airline Edelweiss Air announced on July 31, 2026, that current Eurowings Chief Operating Officer Edi Wolfensberger will take over as its new Chief Executive Officer on October 1, 2026. Wolfensberger will succeed Bernd Bauer, who is stepping down after leading the carrier for 12 years. During Bauer's tenure since taking office in 2014, Edelweiss expanded its route network from around 40 to over 100 destinations and grew its workforce from approximately 500 to almost 1,700 employees. Bauer also served as CEO of Discover Airlines from 2022 to 2025.

international_aviation.headline: 威利華許正式接任印度航空巨頭印地高執行長
international_aviation.summary: 印度航空業者印地高於2026年8月3日發表聲明，歡迎威利華許正式就任執行長。華許曾任愛爾蘭航空、英國航空與國際航空集團執行長，以及國際航空運輸協會理事長。印地高表示，華許將負責營運管理與戰略方向，加速國際擴充，接替於2025年12月離職的前執行長彼得埃爾伯斯。
international_aviation.headline_en: Willie Walsh Begins First Day as IndiGo CEO to Lead Global Expansion
international_aviation.summary_en: IndiGo issued a statement on August 3, 2026, welcoming Willie Walsh as its new chief executive officer following an initial announcement in March 2026. Walsh brings extensive industry experience, having previously served as CEO of Aer Lingus, British Airways, and International Airlines Group, as well as director general of the International Air Transport Association. As CEO, Walsh will oversee overall management and strategic direction, focusing on international growth, operational excellence, and network strategy. He succeeds former CEO Pieter Elbers, who departed in December 2025 following flight disruptions related to regulatory changes.
